wordList.description: Five-letter words Wordle accepts as guesses, from the game source.

frequencies.description: Zipf frequencies derived from the Google Books Ngram corpus.

_license.notice: Frequency data is CC BY 3.0 and requires attribution. If you strip this header, credit Google Books Ngram Viewer somewhere the user can see it.

encoding: 'words' is 14855 concatenated 5-char lowercase words. 'freqs' has one char per word in the same order; zipf = (freqs.charCodeAt(i) - 48) / 10.
